task.description: Write test specifications and test code for EE-08 (Instance cancellation). Cover all acceptance criteria and edge cases from BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md §EE-08: (1) happy path — ACTIVE instance cancel returns 200, tasks/timers cancelled, event appended, status CANCELLED; (2) HTTP 409 for already-terminal instance (CANCELLED/COMPLETED); (3) HTTP 404 for non-existent instance; (4) edge case — no open tasks/timers: event still appended; (5) concurrency edge case — row-level lock ensures first-writer-wins (if testable at integration level). Write specs to tests/specs/EE-08.md and integration tests to tests/integration/main_test.zig.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/EE-08.md written per test guide format with all 5 test cases
Integration tests for EE-08 written in tests/integration/main_test.zig
Tests cover all four EE-08 acceptance criteria and both edge cases
zig build exits 0 after test code added

result.summary: Test specifications and integration test code written for EE-08 (Instance Cancellation). tests/specs/EE-08.md contains 5 test cases (TC-EE-08-01 through TC-EE-08-05) covering all acceptance criteria and edge cases. tests/integration/ee08_cancel_instance_test.zig implements all 5 integration tests using a real PostgreSQL connection. main_test.zig updated to include the new test file. zig build exits 0.
